notes: «سمعوا أبا وائل» makes أبا وائل a link (rule 5); the three before him are co-transmitters of one level
«قال قال عمر» : Umar's question is scene; Hudhayfa speaks the saying and is the last link
«في حديث حماد فقلت لمسروق سل حذيفة» is a remark on another version (the asking of the door): left out, it names no transmitter of this saying
